shots.detail_en: Dawn: the old hall's iron door slides open and CH glides in first, footsteps locked to the opening bell — unseen, the server-room lights glow three seconds before the bell.
shots.sub: 十年了。大厅的空气几点变热——我闭眼都知道。
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: His old seat: teacup set straight, pocket watch laid flat; CH breathes three times with closed eyes, opens them as trading starts.
Opening tick: Lianhua Machinery flashes red once; CH keys his order in the same practiced rhythm of ten years.
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: The instant his order lands, a green bar plunges straight down — bought, then instantly countered.
shots.speaker: 散户乙

shots.detail_en: CH squints at the board, the teacup frozen at his lip.
shots.sub: 刚落座——椅子就被抽走了。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: CH switches to Lianhua Shipping and re-enters, rhythm still steady.
Another counter-strike: the green bar grinds exactly onto the stop-loss line in his mind, to the fraction; his teacup stalls mid-lift.
Behind the second-floor glass, server green dots fall like rain; in the screen sidebar Path Sample Library, the characters LU CHANGHONG surface.
shots.sub: 观察池，又进新样本——他每次，都先看钟，再看单。
shots.speaker: 熊伟

shots.detail_en: Behind the counter RED flicks her abacus, eyes moving between CH and her ledger.
shots.sub: 今天的账——少了一笔赢的。
shots.speaker: 红利

shots.detail_en: CH raises his hand a third time and freezes; three breaths over the pocket watch, then he finally keys in — deliberately half a beat slower.
shots.sub: 我倒要看看——是我快，还是它快。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: Still countered; green light washes CH's face as RETAIL A peers over from afar.
shots.sub: 长虹哥今天……连着三把了。
shots.speaker: 散户甲

shots.detail_en: MANCANG leans in, whispering; CH raises one hand and stops him.
shots.sub: 老大，要不我替你——全仓冲一把？
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: The board: price grinds inch by inch along the red stop line he drew; the hall goes silent but for keystrokes.
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: CH pushes the stop-loss order with his own hand — one soft keystroke; ten years of habit snaps here.
shots.sub: 十年了。我第一次——主动认输。
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: Silence. CH sits unmoved, face flat as a closed board; MANCANG's mouth opens and not one word comes out.
CH gathers his cup and rises, motions still steady — only half a beat slower.
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: In the VIP box the prayer beads start turning again; XIONG watches the retreating figure below.
shots.sub: 认输不是输——装懂，才是输。
shots.speaker: 熊天成

shots.detail_en: Dusk, the nearly empty hall: MANCANG looks left and right, then slips a folded all-in order into the window, chasing Lianhua Tech.
shots.sub: 老大不在……全仓，替他补回来！
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: Tail session: one long green bar drops from Lianhua Tech's height; MANCANG's face freezes at the turn from red light to green, settlement slip crushed in his fist.
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: CH's home at midnight under the desk lamp: he stretches out his hand into the light and looks — it trembles.
shots.sub: 它比我先到，也比我先走。这双手……第一次，跟不上脑子了。
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: Black end-card with white caption text.
